scope: Independent backend re-review main8c1b..a1fd and single no-DB/no-CLI real HTTP parser before probe. No production edits, commits or retries. Original typed7/burst/small not repeated after P1.

finding.title: Declared HTTP trailers lose live-map ownership before body IO and EOF parsing
finding.trigger: One valid chunked HTTP response declares4096 distinct short Trailer names in one header line, then gates body. Body{} completes with300 declared EOF trailer values below Go4KiB parser bound.
finding.observed: Header approval peak273600 drops to65536 before first body read while real Response.Trailer still has4096 entries. EOF has4096 entries/300 populated values with owner still65536. HTTP200, body{}, business request once.

modeled_retained_bytes.method: Existing header charge model8192+sum(len(name)+256+cap(values)*16+sum(len(value))). Conservative model, not measured physical heap bytes.

finding.root_cause: Go fixTrailer deletes Trailer from Header and prebuilds Response.Trailer map. Header callback stops afterDo; body scratch counts only Header and shrinks working to64KiB. Trailer remains live untilEOF/line195 and EOF parsing can allocate more after header accounting stops.
minimal_fix_constraints: Approve comma-expanded Trailer structure before parser allocation; newline count alone misses it.
Keep all live Header and Trailer ownership through body reads.
Approve bounded EOF parser workspace before it allocates, including unannounced trailers.
Do not silently drop declarations. Preserve pre-send NOT_APPLIED/post-send UNKNOWN and no replay.
finding.limits: Only declared4096/300 declared EOF values independently tested. Unannounced trailers, mutation outcomes and cancellation-before-EOF not tested by this probe.

other_static_review: Reviewed pure-read floor/source retention, per-group preDo check, source capacity transfer, completed-body header release, immutable mutation ACK promise, memory-failure cause mapping and bounded two-slot handoffs. No additional confirmed finding. Mongo production code unchanged since prior review. Runtime reviewed separately by core reviewer.
